response.justification: While Bogdan demonstrates strong software engineering fundamentals, TDD practices, and mentoring ability through teaching, he does not meet critical minimum requirements for this technical lead role. Most significantly, he has approximately 1 year of C++ experience versus the required 8 years, only 1-2 years of large-scale infrastructure work versus the required 5 years, and no clear evidence of formal technical leadership experience mentoring engineers or owning platform strategy. His background is primarily in web/product engineering rather than cloud infrastructure or compute platform specialization needed for this role.
strengths: Strong software craftsmanship culture with consistent application of TDD, CI/CD, and engineering best practices across diverse projects and languages

Proven mentoring and teaching ability demonstrated through organizing code dojos, creating courses, conference speaking (FOSS4G 2019), and open-source contributions (GISCollective, Fluent-Asserts, Trial)
Full-stack technical versatility across multiple languages and domains showing ability to navigate complex problems and select appropriate tools for different technical needs
concerns: Critical C++ gap: approximately 1 year of C++ experience (National Instruments, thesis) versus 8-year minimum requirement; primary expertise is in TypeScript, Node.js, and D

Insufficient large-scale infrastructure experience: only 1-2 years of substantial distributed systems work (Dunnhumby media microservices) versus 5-year requirement in compute technologies and distributed systems

No formal technical leadership role: currently Staff Engineer with teaching/mentoring but no clear evidence of team technical leadership, platform strategy ownership, or cloud/DevOps engineer mentoring
